summary: TB-303 bassline sound: squelchy acid house and techno
label: acid 303
body: 16th-note lines with slides and accents; the squelch is in the playing: bring a filter (Revamp) or a resonant sweep on top.

Register: MIDI 31-55 (openDAW names C3 = 60); outside it, it sounds wrong. Sound: HS TB-303/TB-BASS 1, a sampled instrument: make_instrument (sound "HS TB-303/TB-BASS 1") makes the track with its notes in one edit; apply makes it empty.
